name: phone-input
purpose: International phone-number control: an `InputGroup` with a searchable dial-code `Select` on the left and a `type="tel"` input on the right that applies the selected country's mask as the user types and accepts exactly the lengths that country allows. Two v-models (`v-model` for the national digits, `v-model:country` for the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code) carry the editable state; the one-way `update:phone` event hands the form the full E.164 number and whether it is complete. It carries no label or helper text: wrap it in a `Field` (it replaces the v5 `field-phone-number`), and it picks up `id`, `aria-describedby`, `invalid`, `disabled` and `required` from the Field.
useWhen: International phone entry where the user picks a country and types the national number with that country's mask.
Forms that need the full E.164 number and whether it is complete, without per-country length rules in the form.
avoidWhen: The value may include characters the masks reject (extensions, free-form notes) → use `input`.
The input needs addons other than the dial code → use `input-group` and compose it yourself.
related: field` — wraps the control with its label, description and error.
input-group` — the container this control renders around the dial-code select and the input.
select` — the dial-code picker inside the group.
bestPractices: Put it in a `Field` with a `Field.Label`; the label targets the tel input.
v-model` holds the national digits only; read `number` from the `update:phone` payload when you need the E.164 value.
Use `complete` from `update:phone` to decide `invalid` and the `Field.Error` on submit; the control shows no incomplete-number message of its own.
v-model:country` defaults to `'US'`; seed it with the user's country when you know it.
searchPlaceholder` and `searchEmptyLabel` default to English; pass translated copy in localized UIs.

props.name: countries
props.doc: Countries offered by the dial-code Select. When omitted, uses the built-in curated list.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the tel input. Falls back to the selected country's mask when empty.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size forwarded to the InputGroup and the dial-code Select trigger. Heights: small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables both the dial-code Select and the internal input.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the internal input read-only; dial-code Select is also disabled while readonly.

props.name: required
props.doc: Applies the required border on the InputGroup and sets required on the input.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies the invalid border on the InputGroup and sets aria-invalid on the input.

props.name: name
props.doc: HTML name for the internal input (form + vee-validate integration).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the search box that filters the dial-code list. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Search country`).

props.name: searchEmptyLabel
props.doc: Shown in the dial-code list when no country matches the search. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No country found.`).

events.name: update:phone
events.notes: One-way snapshot of the number, emitted once on mount and again whenever the digits or the country change. `PhoneNumber` (exported from the component) is `{ country: string; dialCode: string; digits: string; number: string; complete: boolean }`: `number` is the full E.164 number (`dialCode + digits`, e.g. `'+14155550100'`; `''` while empty) and `complete` is true when the digit count is one the selected country allows. Not a v-model — the field never reads it back.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import PhoneInput from '@aziontech/webkit/phone-input'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const digits = ref('')
  const country = ref('US')
  const phone = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Field
    required
    class="max-w-(--container-xs)"
  >
    <Field.Label>Phone</Field.Label>
    <PhoneInput
      v-model="digits"
      v-model:country="country"
      name="phone"
      @update:phone="phone = $event"
    />
    <Field.Description>We'll use this to send the verification code.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>
